content.value: An aluminum rod is rigidly attached between a steel rod and a bronze rod as shown in Figure-1(b). Axial loads are applied at the positions indicated. Find the maximum value of P that will not exceed a stress in steel of 140 MPa, in aluminum of 90 MPa or in bronze of 100MPa.
